name: The Drowned Colossus
blurb: Every spawnling in the Hollow answers to one, much older, shape.

name: The Frost Yeti King
blurb: The summit belongs to whatever can survive the cold longest.

name: The Deep Troll King
blurb: Every tunnel in the dark eventually leads back to him.

name: The Savanna Warlord
blurb: Every pack on the grassland answers to one crown.

name: The Glacial Ape-King
blurb: Old enough to remember when the ice was thicker.

name: The Orca Vanguard King
blurb: The whole Current clears out the moment his pod surfaces.

name: Wound Reaver's Domain
blurb: The Swampmire does not heal. It just remembers where you bled.

name: The Phoenix Ember King
blurb: Kill it and the Foundry only gets brighter.

name: The Avalanche Colossus
blurb: The mountain itself decided it had had enough visitors.

name: The Rootworm Hive Mind
blurb: It does not have a face. It has never needed one.

name: The Hollow Oath
blurb: The Sanctum’s oldest promise, and the one it keeps most literally.

name: The Warhorse Sovereign
blurb: Every stable on the Approach was bred for this one rider.

name: The Cave Warlord
blurb: Everything on the Sundered Peak, in the end, answers to him.
